content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

A sovereign digital commerce stack is not just a workaround forStripe, PayPal, or Gumroad restrictions. It's a foundation for your online store, built from the ground up with free and open-source tools that give you full control over your infrastructure, fees, and customer data. This means you can sell your digital products without relying on a single platform, accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, and keep your customers' data securely in your possession.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A sovereign digital commerce stack is typically hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provides a free and scalable platform for your online store. The backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automates tasks such as order processing and payment verification. Meanwhile, NOWPayments handles the automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, without the need for KYC or buyer accounts.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges only 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of a sovereign digital commerce stack include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handles file delivery, while the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides a comprehensive blueprint for building, deploying, and scaling your stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to build, deploy, and scale your stack. Next, choose your hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question to ask is: 'How much can I save by switching to a sovereign digital commerce stack?' The answer is simple: at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments retains $921. That's a significant savings, especially for creators who sell high-volume digital products.
You can save up to $921 per month by switching to a sovereign digital commerce stack.

If you're looking for more information on building a sovereign digital commerce stack, be sure to check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the blueprints and templates you need to get started. You can also browse our products at Shop URL: https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Additionally, if you're struggling to find a platform that accepts Bitcoin, consider using NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges only 0.5% fee.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, take the following steps: Choose your hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Configure Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Choose a file delivery service, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test and deploy your stack, and start selling your digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad.
